description.en: Classic Har Gow is a steamed shrimp dumpling made with shrimp, wheat starch, tapioca starch, bamboo shoot, sesame oil and served as four translucent pleated dumplings in a bamboo steamer.
description.yue: 蝦餃係香港茶樓常見嘅蒸餃，講究皮薄餡鮮，通常放喺竹籠趁熱上枱。

alt.en: Warm tea-house photograph of Classic Har Gow
alt.yue: 港式茶樓木枱上嘅蝦餃

dishes.imagePrompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: square dim-sum catalog food photograph
Primary request: an original, appetizing photograph of Classic Har Gow (蝦餃), featuring shrimp, wheat starch, tapioca starch, bamboo shoot, sesame oil; present it as four translucent pleated dumplings in a bamboo steamer
Scene/backdrop: warm Hong Kong tea-house tabletop of dark honey-toned wood, understated and uncluttered
Subject: only the specified Classic Har Gow; ingredients and traditional presentation must be visually accurate
Style/medium: photorealistic natural food photography, premium but believable restaurant presentation
Composition/framing: square 1:1, close three-quarter overhead view, dish centered, full serving visible, generous clean margins
Lighting/mood: warm window light, soft natural shadows, inviting yum-cha atmosphere
Color palette: natural ingredient colours, warm wood, restrained porcelain or bamboo serving ware
Materials/textures: realistic food texture, natural wood grain, believable bamboo or porcelain
Constraints: one distinct dish only; culturally accurate Hong Kong Cantonese presentation; no people; no hands; no text; no menus; no logos; no watermark; no decorative lettering
Avoid: multiple dishes, plastic-looking food, excessive garnish, fusion styling, duplicate serving vessels, cropped dish, illustration, CGI
